findings: Learner overview (and duplicated summary) calls 出 a foot stepping out of an enclosure, but the cited analyses describe the upper 止 as a foot and the lower 凵/囗 as an enclosure, without establishing a separate person. Rephrase as “a foot stepping out of an enclosure” or “a foot-shaped element stepping out” only if that matches the cited construction; remove the unsupported person implication in the historical-glyph caption, which calls it a figure.
